description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance of various models across three different evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variables, ordered from left to right as Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, an obscured label covered by a solid grey rectangle, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy / Correlation" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to slightly above 0.8, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2 and minor tick marks every 0.05. The data is presented in grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three adjacent bars. According to the legend positioned at the top center, the light beige bars represent "Sentiment Acc.", the pink bars represent "STS Corr.", and the light blue bars represent "Paraphrase Acc." Across the categories, the light beige "Sentiment Acc." bars range from a high of approximately 0.53 for the Single-task_baseline to a low of roughly 0.49 for both the obscured category and 2-Tier SimCSE. The pink "STS Corr." bars display the widest variation, starting at the lowest value of approximately 0.50 for the Single-task_baseline and reaching the highest overall value in the chart at approximately 0.81 for 2-Tier SimCSE. The light blue "Paraphrase Acc." bars remain relatively consistent across all groups, ranging narrowly between approximately 0.77 for Unsupervised_SimCSE and 0.79 for the Single-task_baseline. The categories do not appear to be sorted in a strict ascending or descending order based on any single metric, and aside from the obscured fourth category label on the horizontal axis, no specific bars or data points are visually emphasized.
